title: Slack Capital: eXoZymes’ Path to Computational Biomanufacturing
summary: Slack Capital on Substack : What if eXoZymes’ biggest opportunity isn’t a single molecule, but an AI-powered engine that combines computational design with cell-free biomanufacturing to repeatedly turn previously inaccessible chemistry into new products - and then do it all over again?'
